name: vLLM-TorchTPU quickstart
description: Ready-to-run online serving, offline inference, and multimodal examples for PyTorch-native TPU serving.

assertions.assertion: vLLM-TorchTPU quickstart provides official guidance on Ready-to-run online serving, offline inference, and multimodal examples for PyTorch-native TPU serving.
TorchTPU is the native PyTorch runtime replacing the deprecated PyTorch/XLA backend for TPU workloads.
vLLM-TorchTPU is the out-of-tree PyTorch-native serving backend for vLLM on TPUs, distinct from the JAX-native vllm-tpu backend.
